publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.textBefore: Seancy is a personal project, with no commercial structure, developed and operated from France. There isn't a dedicated public contact address yet: in the meantime, you can reach us

service.title: The service
service.textBefore: Seancy lets you discover movies and shows, keep track of a personal library ("watched", "want to watch", custom lists), and receive notifications about new releases. Catalog data, pages, posters, and streaming availability come from third-party services (see our
service.textAfter: ) and are provided for informational purposes only: we do not guarantee their accuracy or completeness.

account.title: Account and sign-in
account.text: Creating an account is done via email, using a single-use sign-in link (no password is stored). You are responsible for the security of access to your email inbox, the only way to access your account.

usage.title: Permitted use
usage.text: The service is provided free of charge, for personal, non-commercial use. Any automated or abusive use (mass data scraping, bypassing security measures or rate limits) is prohibited.

availability.title: Availability and evolution of the service
availability.text1: Seancy is a personal project under active development: features, appearance, and availability may change, including being interrupted, without notice. No guarantee of continuous availability is provided (no service level commitment).
availability.text2: The service is free today and will remain so for its current features; an optional funding method (one-off donations) may be introduced in the future, without making access to the service paid.

liability.title: Liability
liability.text: The service is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. To the extent permitted by French law, the publisher cannot be held liable for damages resulting from the use or inability to use the service.

law.title: Governing law
law.text: These terms are governed by French law.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.text: These terms may be updated as the service evolves. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page; we encourage you to check it regularly.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.textBefore: Seancy is a personal project, with no commercial structure, operated from France. The data processing described below is therefore governed by French law and the GDPR. There isn't a dedicated public contact address yet: in the meantime, you can reach us

account.label: Account
account.text: : your email address (the only information requested at sign-up), used for single-use link/code sign-in — no password is stored. You can change it from your profile: the new address is only saved once you enter a code sent to it (the pending request is kept for 15 minutes at most), and a notice is sent to the previous one. You can also set an optional display name, visible on your account card and synced across your devices, and an optional profile photo: it is cropped and resized on your device before upload (which strips its metadata, including GPS location), kept until you remove it, and then replaces your Gravatar picture.

library.label: Personal library
library.text: : the movies/shows you mark as "watched" or "want to watch", your custom lists and their content, and the titles you mark "not interested" in the "For you" section. These signals are used to compute your personalized recommendations, entirely server-side. If you turn on profile sharing (optional, off by default), your watched/watchlist/lists along with your ratings, display name and profile picture (your own, or else your Gravatar picture, if you have one) become visible read-only to anyone who has the share link — never your email address or your "not interested" titles. You can turn sharing off at any time, which permanently invalidates the link.

preferences.label: Preferences
preferences.text: : excluded genres, favorite streaming platforms, region.

push.label: Push notifications
push.text: (if you enable them): your browser's technical subscription identifier and the associated encryption keys, used solely to send you the new-release notifications you requested. If you are signed in to your account on this device, this subscription is linked to your account so these notifications can be delivered directly in the app on your signed-in devices; it is unlinked as soon as you sign out on this device.

technical.label: Technical data
technical.text: : your IP address is processed briefly to limit abuse (anti-spam on sign-in), without being kept in a form identifiable to your account.

sharedLists.label: Shared lists
sharedLists.text: (if you choose to share a custom list): its name, its content, your ratings for the titles in it and your display name become visible read-only to anyone who has the link — never your email address. You can stop sharing at any time from the list, which permanently invalidates the link.

follows.label: Follows
follows.text: : when you follow a profile, we store that follow and its date. It is used to show follower/following counts and lists, your activity feed, and to notify the person you follow. If your profile is shared, your display name and a link to your profile appear in those lists; otherwise you only appear as a "private profile". A shared profile can also be found by its display name in the profile search available to signed-in members. You can unfollow a profile at any time.

reminders.label: “Notify me” reminders
reminders.text: : when you turn on the bell for an upcoming title, we store on your account that title (identifier, name, poster, release date), the date of the reminder and the streaming services already known for it. They are only used to notify you on release day and when the title arrives on a streaming service. Turning the bell off deletes the reminder.

sharedProfile.label: Shared profile and username
sharedProfile.text: (if you choose to share your profile): what you've watched, your watchlist, your custom lists, your ratings, your display name and your profile picture become visible read-only to anyone who has the link — never your email address. You can also pick an optional, unique username: it appears in the shared profile's address (/u/your_username) and on the profile itself. Turning sharing off makes the profile unreachable, including through the username; you can change or clear the username at any time from your profile.

why.title: Why we use it
why.text: This data is used solely to operate the account, library, and notifications you explicitly requested. The legal basis is the performance of the service you ask us for (account, watchlist) and, for push notifications, your explicit consent (manually enabled in the app, revocable at any time).

sharing.title: Who this data is shared with
sharing.intro: Seancy relies on the following providers to operate:

tmdb.label: TMDB
tmdb.text: (The Movie Database): provides the catalog, pages, and posters — no personal data is sent to it, only content requests.

resend.label: Resend
resend.text: : sends the emails containing your sign-in link/code, as well as the confirmation code and notice for an email address change — receives your email address (both old and new, in that case) for this purpose only.

recaptcha.label: Google reCAPTCHA
recaptcha.text: : protects certain forms against bots, under Google's privacy policy.

cloudflare.label: Cloudflare
cloudflare.text: : hosts the application and the database (Workers, D1).

sentry.label: Sentry
sentry.text: : receives technical errors occurring in the application (browser and server), for the sole purpose of diagnosing and fixing them. An error may occasionally contain technical details (URL visited, error message) but no account data is intentionally sent to it.

analytics.label: Cloudflare Web Analytics
analytics.text: : anonymous audience measurement (page views, visitors) — no cookies, no persistent identifier, no personal data.

gravatar.label: Gravatar
gravatar.text: (Automattic): displays your profile picture if you've set one up linked to your email address. We never send your email address in clear text to Gravatar, only its fingerprint (MD5 hash), in line with how this service works.

sharing.outro: None of this data is sold or used for advertising purposes.

cookies.title: Cookies and measurement tools
cookies.text: Seancy uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure site traffic anonymously, without cookies or identifiers that would allow tracking a person from one visit to another. Sentry is used to track and diagnose technical errors (see above). Neither of these two tools is used for advertising or profiling purposes. Should a new audience-measurement or ad-tracking tool ever be added, this policy will be updated beforehand to reflect it.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.textBefore: Your data is kept for as long as your account exists. You can delete it yourself at any time, along with all associated data, from Profile → Account ("Delete my account" button): deletion is immediate and permanent. You can also request its deletion

rights.title: Your rights
rights.textBefore: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port, and object with regard to your data. You can export a copy of your data at any time from Profile → Account ("Export my data" button), or exercise all of these rights
rights.textAfter: , and lodge a complaint with the CNIL if you believe your rights are not being respected.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: This policy may evolve along with the service, in particular if new tools (audience measurement, crowdfunding...) are added. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.
